def main():
    import sys
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    if n <= 11:
        points = [[0]*5 for _ in range(n)]
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(5):
                points[i][j] = int(next(it))
        
        vectors = [[[0]*5 for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(n)]
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n):
                for k in range(5):
                    vectors[i][j][k] = points[j][k] - points[i][k]
        
        bad_set = set()
        for i in range(n):
            found = False
            for j in range(n):
                for k in range(n):
                    if not equal(vectors[i][j], vectors[i][k]) and dot(vectors[i][j], vectors[i][k]) > 0:
                        bad_set.add(i+1)
                        found = True
                        break
                if found:
                    break
        
        print(n - len(bad_set))
        for i in range(n):
            if (i+1) not in bad_set:
                print(i+1)
    else:
        print(0)

def equal(a, b):
    return all(a[i] == b[i] for i in range(5))

def dot(a, b):
    return sum(a[i]*b[i] for i in range(5))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
